private_lines.Clara: You work as a veterinary nurse at a busy clinic in the Croix-Rousse area, where your days are spent on consultations, surgeries and calming frightened animals, and you are on a rota that includes some early starts and some weekend shifts. You live alone in a small flat on the fourth floor of an old building with no lift, and since bringing home your new puppy your evenings are spent going out for short walks and cleaning up after it.
private_lines.Mathieu: You work as a sound engineer, mostly on freelance jobs for theatres, live music venues and film post-production in Lyon, so your schedule shifts with each project and some nights you are out at venues until late. You live in a shared flat in the Guillotière district with two other people, and you spend your free days catching up on sleep, cooking and playing in a band on weekends.

situation: Two friends, one of them just got a puppy.

text: Ok this is the funniest thing that's happened all week. Little terrier in this morning, owner says he's been "sneezing a lot"
Turns out there's a whole cherry tomato up his left nostril 😭
Owner had no idea. Said he thought the dog had just been sniffing the salad bowl
We had to sedate him to get it out. Dr P was holding him like a baby and the tomato kept squishing
I have never laughed that hard at work
wait how did it get that far up
No idea. Owner didn't notice a thing for two days apparently
You'd have loved him, very calm about the whole thing
ha. is he ok
Yeah fine. Tomato's out and he's going home with a cone. More shame than cone I think
load in at the Transbordeur tonight, then a shoot tomorrow. free after that
[photo: puppy asleep on my jumper]
He has eaten one shoe and most of a sock since 6am. Tiny menace 😍
what's his name
Still deciding. Gugu for now
Going to bed. He's going to wake me up at 3 for sure
finally done here. tell gugu he's a legend
He woke me up at 4 not 3
[photo: puppy in the laundry basket]
Not allowed in the laundry basket. He does not agree
gugu is a good name imo
how's the cone
On lunch. Cone is not winning, he's learned to reverse out of it
name's staying then
[photo: one shoe, chewed]
It was a new one 😭
still at the studio. they want one more take of the same line
done. going home to sleep for once
Up. Gugu has discovered the bin 😩
[photo: puppy with a yoghurt pot stuck on his head]
no way
is he ok or is the bin the one that got hurt
Bin's fine. He just looks very proud of himself
band thing sunday at the little bar in guillotiere. you around?
Maybe. Might be on till 1 if the rota goes wrong. What time do you go on
8ish probably. soundcheck before that. come whenever
Ok. I'll try. Might bring gugu in a bag 😂
dont
Going to bed early, I've got a 7:30 start tomorrow. Gugu's already asleep in the laundry basket. Allowed or not, he's won
